# spaceman role

Roles of a space (--space) and role templates.

Aliases: `roles`.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman role delete`](#spaceman-role-delete) | Remove a role from a space |
| [`spaceman role get`](#spaceman-role-get) | Show one of a space's roles |
| [`spaceman role list`](#spaceman-role-list) | A space's roles |
| [`spaceman role preview`](#spaceman-role-preview) | A role's effective configuration and where each value comes from |
| [`spaceman role set`](#spaceman-role-set) | Configure a role in a space (creates it, or replaces its configuration) |
| [`spaceman role template`](#spaceman-role-template) | Role templates: list, show, create and update |

## spaceman role delete

Remove a role from a space.

```sh
spaceman role delete <name> [flags]
```

API: `delete-space-role` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

## spaceman role set

Configure a role in a space (creates it, or replaces its configuration).

```sh
spaceman role set <name> [flags]
```

API: `save-space-role` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--instructions` | string |  | role instructions |
| `--instructions-file` | string |  | read --instructions from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--model` | string |  | model |
| `--profile` | string |  | harness profile ID |
| `--prompt` | string |  | prompt ID |
| `--prompt-pin` | string |  | published prompt version to pin (empty follows the latest) |
| `--setting` | string, repeatable |  | harness setting (key=value, repeatable) |
| `--space` | string |  | space ID or slug (env SPACEMAN_SPACE) |
| `--template` | string |  | role template ID (required for a new role) |

## spaceman role template create

Add a role template.

```sh
spaceman role template create <slug> [flags]
```

API: `save-role-template` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--kind` | string |  | control, worker, kb, dreamer or diagnostic (required) |
| `--memory-conventions` | string |  | memory conventions |
| `--memory-conventions-file` | string |  | read --memory-conventions from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--name` | string |  | name |
| `--profile` | string |  | harness profile ID |
| `--prompt` | string |  | prompt ID |
| `--prompt-pin` | string |  | published prompt version to pin (empty follows the latest) |
| `--setting` | string, repeatable |  | harness setting (key=value, repeatable) |

## spaceman role template get

Show a role template (ID or slug).

```sh

```

API: `get-role-template` ([HTTP API](../api)).

## spaceman role template list

Role templates.

## spaceman role template update

Edit a role template (only the flags given change).

```sh
spaceman role template update <template> [flags]
```

API: `get-role-template`, `save-role-template` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--description` | string |  | description |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--memory-conventions` | string |  | memory conventions |
| `--memory-conventions-file` | string |  | read --memory-conventions from a file (- reads standard input) |
| `--name` | string |  | name |
| `--profile` | string |  | harness profile ID |
| `--prompt` | string |  | prompt ID |
| `--prompt-pin` | string |  | published prompt version to pin (empty follows the latest) |
| `--setting` | string, repeatable |  | harness setting (key=value, repeatable) |
